name: LGMS Berhad
overview: 2026年，LGMS Berhad 完成了对 Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd 27.0% 股权的收购，总代价为 RM22.68 million，其中 RM16.065 million 已于 2026 年 1 月 22 日支付，余额 RM6.615 million 根据利润保证安排保留。公司未公告其他业务板块的扩张、缩减或合约获得事项。最新一季（2026-06-30）营收同比微增 0.4%，净利润同比下降 13.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, LGMS Berhad completed the acquisition of a 27.0% equity interest in Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd for a total consideration of RM22.68 million, with RM16.065 million paid on 22 January 2026 and the remaining RM6.615 million retained under a profit guarantee arrangement. No other announcements were made regarding expansion, reduction, or contract wins in other business segments.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd 27.0% 股权，总代价 RM22.68 million，已支付 RM16.065 million，余额 RM6.615 million 按利润保证安排保留。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of a 27.0% equity interest in Antarex Holdings Sdn Bhd for a total consideration of RM22.68 million, with RM16.065 million paid and the remaining RM6.615 million retained under a profit guarantee arrangement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 宣布 Supplemental SSA 的先决条件于 2026 年 1 月 12 日全部满足，协议变为无条件，预计收购于 2026 年 1 月底完成。
actions.text_en: Announced that all conditions precedent of the Supplemental SSA were fulfilled on 12 January 2026, making the agreement unconditional, and the acquisition was expected to complete by end-January 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于 2026 年 1 月 8 日与 AHSB 及 Tan Pek Loon 签订 Supplemental SSA，继续收购 3,089,135 股 AHSB 股份（27.0% 股权），卖方调整为 Tan Pek Loon。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Supplemental SSA with AHSB and Tan Pek Loon on 8 January 2026 to continue acquiring 3,089,135 AHSB shares (27.0% equity interest), with the seller adjusted to Tan Pek Loon.
